summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The KraneShares 2x Long BIDU Daily ETF (KBDU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, net fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Baidu, Inc. Sponsored ADR Class A (NASDAQ: BIDU), through direct investments and derivatives. KBDU was launched on Nov 19, 2025 and is issued by KraneShares.
